title: Modern Survey Sampling Methods & Weight Calibration
description: Comprehensive course on Stratified Multi-Stage sampling designs, calculating sampling multipliers, handling cluster intraclass correlation, and post-stratification weighting.

title: Comprehensive Survey Questionnaire Design & CAPI Automation
description: Formulating clear questions, cognitive testing, building validation logic trees for Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) on mobile tablets.
curriculum: Question Types, Recall Bias and Sensitive Topics
Logic Rules, Skips and Consistency Validations in CAPI

title: Compilation of Consumer Price Index (CPI) & WPI
description: Step-by-step practical training on Laspeyres price index formulation, geometric mean aggregation, seasonal clothing adjustments, and inflation reporting.
curriculum: Index Numbers Principles and Laspeyres/Paasche Formulations
Weekly Price Collection and Quotation Scrubbing
Sub-group and Headline Inflation Index Computation

title: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Microdata Analysis
description: Understanding activity statuses (ps+ss vs CWS), unravelling unit-level record layouts, and computing national employment indicators.
curriculum: PLFS Survey Concept, Sampling and Rotation Panel Scheme
Record Layouts: Household, Person and Activity Schedules
Calculating LFPR, WPR, and Unemployment Rate

title: System of National Accounts (SNA) & GDP Estimation
description: In-depth course on SNA 2008 principles, production boundaries, double deflation methodologies, financial intermediation services (FISIM), and supply-use balancing.
curriculum: Gross Value Added (GVA) by Sector (Agriculture, Industry, Services)

title: Python for Statistical Officers & Data Wrangling
description: Hands-on Python training tailored for official statistical offices. Uses Pandas and NumPy to ingest raw ASCII fixed-width survey files and export clean tabular indicators.
curriculum: Pandas Series and DataFrames: Filtering, Indexing and Reshaping
Grouping, Aggregation and Exporting Statistical Summaries

title: Advanced Data Engineering & Pipeline Automation in Python
description: High performance data manipulation with Polars, vectorised data cleaning, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for statistical releases.
curriculum: Polars vs Pandas for 10M+ Row Datasets

title: R for Official Survey Data & Complex Design Analysis
description: Mastering the 'survey' library in R: svydesign specification, computing standard errors with design effects, and generating publication-ready tables with Quarto.
curriculum: Tidyverse for Data Cleaning and Transformation
Specifying Stratified Multi-Stage svydesign in R
Subpopulation Estimation and Standard Error Computation

title: SQL for Large Scale Administrative & Survey Registries
description: Relational data extraction, window functions, linking administrative registers (PAN, GSTN, Udyam) with survey frames, and high-performance querying.

title: Statistical Data Visualisation & Dashboard Architecture
description: Principles of statistical data presentation, avoiding misleading chart elements, designing accessible public dashboards, and interactive maps.
curriculum: Best Practices in Statistical Chart Selection

title: Data Governance, Confidentiality & DPDP Act Compliance
description: Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, statistical disclosure control (SDC), k-anonymity, cell suppression in microdata release, and compliance with the DPDP Act.
curriculum: UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics
Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act Requirements
Ethical Handling of Sovereign Administrative Data
